name: google-bard
label: Google Gemini
description: Google Gemini is a conversational AI chatbot, based initially on the LaMDA family of large language models and later the PaLM LLM.

fields.title: Server URL
fields.description: Specify the URL of the Google Gemini server to connect and perform automated operations.
fields.name: server_url
fields.tooltip: Specify the URL of the Google Gemini server to connect and perform automated operations.

fields.title: API Key
fields.description: Specify the API key to access the endpoint to connect and perform the automated operations
fields.name: api_key
fields.tooltip: Specify the API key to access the endpoint to connect and perform the automated operations

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is set to True.
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is set to True.

operations.title: Get All Model List
operations.description: Retrieves a list of all language models from Google Gemini based on the pagination criteria and other parameters you have specified.

parameters.title: Page Size
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the maximum count of records that this operation fetches from Google Gemini. By default, this option is set to 50. You can specify a maximum value of 1000 and minimum value of 1.
parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify the maximum count of records that this operation fetches from Google Gemini. By default, this option is set to 50. You can specify a maximum value of 1000 and minimum value of 1.

parameters.title: Page Token
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the token for the next set of items to return. The previously returned response contains a nextPageToken element containing a PageToken parameter. Use this parameter as a starting point to get the next page of results.
parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify the token for the next set of items to return. The previously returned response contains a nextPageToken element containing a PageToken parameter. Use this parameter as a starting point to get the next page of results.

operations.title: Get Model Details
operations.description: Retrieves information for a specific model from Google Gemini based on the model name you have specified.

parameters.title: Model Name
parameters.description: Specify the name of the model whose details are to be retrieved from Google Gemini.
parameters.name: name

operations.title: Generate Text
operations.description: Generates a response from the model based on the model name, text prompts, and other input parameters you have specified.

parameters.title: Model Name
parameters.description: Specify the name of the model based on which to generate text in Google Gemini.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the model based on which to generate text in Google Gemini.
parameters.name: name

parameters.title: Contents
parameters.description: Specify a JSON object containing either a single question or the complete chat history when providing a conversation in the format: [{'parts':[{ 'text': 'free text',... }],'role': (user/model)},...]. Ref: https://ai.google.dev/api/caching#Content

parts.text: Can you check this Python function for errors?

parameters.name: contents
parameters.tooltip: Specify a JSON object containing either a single question or the complete chat history when providing a conversation in the format: [{'parts':[{ 'text': 'free text',... }],'role': (user/model)},...]. Ref: https://ai.google.dev/api/caching#Content

parameters.title: Safety Settings
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a list of unique SafetySetting instances for blocking unsafe content.
parameters.name: safetySettings
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify a list of unique SafetySetting instances for blocking unsafe content. Note: There should not be more than one setting for each SafetyCategory type. It will block any prompts and responses that fail to meet the thresholds set by these settings. Ref: https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content#safetysetting For e.g.: [{'category':'HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT','threshold':'BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH'}]

parameters.title: System Instructions
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the system instructions used to guide the behavior and responses of Gemini models.
parameters.name: system_instruction
parameters.placeholder: You are a SOC analyst and you are triaging alerts
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify the system instructions used to guide the behavior and responses of Gemini models.

parameters.title: Stop Sequences
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a set of character sequences (up to 5) that stop the output generation.
parameters.name: stopSequences
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify a set of character sequences (up to 5) that stop the output generation.

parameters.title: Temperature
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the value of the temperature to control the randomness of the output. Values can range from [0.0,1.0], inclusive. A value closer to 1.0 produces responses that are more varied and creative, while a value closer to 0.0 typically results in a more straightforward responses from the model. NOTE: The default value varies by model.
parameters.name: temperature
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Values can range from [0.0,1.0], inclusive. A value closer to 1.0 will produce responses that are more varied and creative, while a value closer to 0.0 will typically result in more straightforward responses from the model.

parameters.title: Maximum Output Tokens
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the maximum number of tokens to include in a candidate. If unset, defaults to 64.
parameters.name: maxOutputTokens
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) It is a configuration parameter that sets a hard limit on the length of the model's generated response. It is measured in tokens, which are the basic units of text processed by the AI (roughly 4 characters per token in English)..

parameters.title: Cumulative Probability (TopP)
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the maximum cumulative probability of tokens to consider when sampling.  NOTE: The default value varies by model, see the topP attribute of the Model returned by the Get Model Details response
parameters.name: topP
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Model uses combined Top-k and nucleus sampling. Tokens are sorted based on their assigned probabilities so that only the most liekly tokens are considered. Top-k sampling directly limits the maximum number of tokens to consider, while Nucleus sampling limits number of tokens based on the cumulative probability.

parameters.title: Token (TopK)
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the maximum number of tokens to consider when sampling. NOTE: The default value varies by model, see the topK attribute of the Model returned by the Get Model Details response.
parameters.name: topK
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Model uses combined Top-k and nucleus sampling. Top-k sampling considers the set of topK most probable tokens. By default, it set to 40.

parameters.title: Thinking Levels
parameters.name: thinkingLevel
parameters.tooltip: Gemini models engage in dynamic thinking by default, automatically adjusting the amount of reasoning effort based on the complexity of the user's request. However, if you have specific latency constraints or require the model to engage in deeper reasoning than usual, you can optionally use thinking level to control thinking behavior.
parameters.description: (Optional) Gemini models use dynamic thinking by default, automatically adjusting their reasoning effort based on the complexity of the user's request. Optionally, you can specify a thinking level to control the amount of reasoning performed when you have specific latency requirements or need deeper reasoning than the default behavior provides.

operations.title: Generate Embedding
operations.description: Generates an embedding from the model based on the model name and content you have specified.

parameters.title: Model Name
parameters.description: Specify the name of the model based on which to generate embedding in Google Gemini.
parameters.name: name

parameters.title: Content
parameters.description: Specify the free-form input text that the model turns into an embedding in Google Gemini.
parameters.name: content
parameters.tooltip: Specify the free-form input text that the model turns into an embedding in Google Gemini.

parameters.title: Task Type
parameters.name: taskType
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify the type of task for which the embedding will be used, as described here: https://ai.google.dev/api/embeddings#tasktype.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the type of task for which the embedding will be used, as described here: https://ai.google.dev/api/embeddings#tasktype.

parameters.title: Output Dimensionality
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify an optional reduced dimensionality for the output embedding. When set, the embedding is truncated to the specified number of dimensions by removing values from the end of the vector. This parameter is supported only by newer embedding models released in 2024 and later and is not supported by the models/embedding-001 model.
parameters.name: outputDimensionality

operations.title: Count Message Token
operations.description: Retrieves the number of tokens that the model creates from the prompt based on the model name messages you have specified.

parameters.title: Model Name
parameters.description: Specify the name of the model based on which to retrieve token from Google Gemini.
parameters.name: name

parameters.title: Messages
parameters.description: Specify the list of messages based on which to retrieve token count from Google Gemini. NOTE: If the total input size exceeds the model's inputTokenLimit the input is truncated: The oldest items are dropped from the messages.

parts.text: Can you check this Python function for errors?
Of course. Please provide the code snippet.
def add(a, b): return a + b

parameters.name: messages
parameters.tooltip: Note: If the total input size exceeds the model's inputTokenLimit the input will be truncated: The oldest items will be dropped from messages. For e.g [{"content":"hi"}]
